grammar.summary: 本课学习表"正名"的 vindicate 与主动表被动倾向。

points.title: 表"审判"的语义场
points.explanation: He was tried for heresy / forced to recant. tried = 被审判；recant = 公开放弃（观点）。历史场景的动词精准度。

examples.en: Galileo was forced to deny what he knew to be true.
examples.cn: 伽利略被迫否认他所知道的真理。

points.title: what he knew to be true 复合从句
points.explanation: deny what he knew to be true：what 引导宾语从句内嵌不定式补语，长句骨架练习。

examples.en: His views have long since been vindicated.
examples.cn: 他的观点早已得到证实。
